problem: WP11 legitimately replaces the current alternative v1 with v2. The historical portfolio and campaign need an authorized immutable v1 origin after it disappears from current alternatives.

request.candidateDigest: digest obtained from the authenticated persisted binding or campaign

required_change: Import createPortfolioCandidateHistoryReader from the new WP13 proof.ts module.
In createSfReviewPortfolioHistory, create the reader with state: authority.state, cases: business.cases, results: business.results, evidence: input.evidence and host.
Pass the reader as readHistoricalCandidate to createPortfolioHistoricalProvenance beside readHistoricalBinding/caseFor/cases/evidence/host.

When the host composes createPortfolioCampaign, inject the same reader as readHistoricalCandidate. No published campaign callsite was confirmed in the inspected host files; do not invent a source path or claim that consumer is already wired.
behavior: Original current alternative continues through its existing exact id/version/content validation.
Only when the old version is absent, the reader can recover a matching immutable C08 case-transaction snapshot, or an exact ChoiceRecord with its choice-recorded ledger event.
The recovered candidate must match the anchored digest and a readable original C08 scenario with the same input/result digests and case ancestry.
Current case authorization and all request/result/coverage/source evidence are revalidated twice. Denied C08 or revoked evidence remains denied, including the ChoiceRecord fallback.
No snapshot or ledger write occurs, no historic value is recalculated from a current price, and no future case version or substituted incarnation is accepted.
remaining_limitation: If no immutable case transaction contains the original candidate and no matching chosen snapshot/ledger exists, return unavailable. This can occur for legacy/seeded data or an unchosen promotion whose producer did not retain a complete case snapshot. WP11 must expose an authenticated historical request/result origin for such a producer; a bare candidate hash, latest alternative with the same id, or invented snapshot must not restore access.
